title: China production-input prices mostly declined in early August
summary: China's monitored production-input basket showed broad downward movement in early August: 31 of 50 tracked products fell in price, while 12 increased and 7 were unchanged. The largest extracted declines included Pure Benzene (Petroleum Benzene, Industrial Grade) at -7.3% and Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) at -3.5%.
what_happened: China's monitored production-input basket showed broad downward movement in early August: 31 of 50 tracked products fell in price, while 12 increased and 7 were unchanged. The largest extracted declines included Pure Benzene (Petroleum Benzene, Industrial Grade) at -7.3% and Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) at -3.5%.
interpretation: The release indicates broad rather than uniform downward price movement across the monitored basket. 31 of 50 products declined, versus 12 increases and 7 unchanged. The figures are wholesale/market prices of important means of production, so they are a useful input-cost watchpoint but do not by themselves establish changes in producer prices, export prices or Canadian landed costs.
